description: Performance sweep - Go: valkey-glide-go vs go-redis (high-throughput configs). There is no bench-aws.sh version flag for this client: bump github.com/valkey-io/valkey-glide/go/v2 in go/go.mod (and go.sum) on a pushed ref and pass --repo-tag. go-redis is the stable yardstick, so compare GLIDE/go-redis ratios across runs to cancel instance-to-instance noise. Connections and iterations match perf-ruby. infra/provision.sh does not install the Go toolchain yet, so this matrix fails on bench-aws.sh until that block is added; run it locally with make benchmark-matrix.
